answer_1.quote: We use three LLMs (Gemma, Llama2, Mixtral) in our study and prompt them to simulate survey participants to answer the open-ended question about the most important political problem in Germany.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text responses to survey questions

answer_2.quote: To compare the representativeness of the LLM answers with the original survey data and to measure the association between the variables, we used the following evaluation metrics. Jensen-Shannon (JS) Divergence... Entropy... Conditional Entropy... Information Gain... Cramér's V...
